name: browser-snaps
description: A lightweight Chrome extension for capturing website navigation pages as PDF or PNG.
author: Lewis John Villamor

scripts.check: node --check src/audit.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/perf.js && node --check src/indicator.js && node --check src/offscreen.js && node --check src/pdf.js && node --check src/platform-chrome.js && node --check src/platform-firefox.js && node --check src/platform-safari.js && node --check src/popup.js && node --check src/results.js && node --check src/storage.js && node --check src/zip.js
scripts.validate:firefox: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:firefox
scripts.validate:safari: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:safari
scripts.validate:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:store && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:safari
scripts.validate:store: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:store
